method: Direct visual inspection of the actual generated PNG files through the image viewing tool
observations: Readable titles, units, axis ticks and variant labels; no clipped text or overlapping panels
Each effects panel displays its own numerical y scale, five seed points, mean, interval and zero reference; the paired CSV retains every value
Sample panels show the prespecified first confirmation seed for each dataset at 10000 updates, with shared fixed axes
Qualitative sample figure displays the first1024 of2048 samples; full2048 used for metrics
limits: Visual inspection is not a numerical verifier; numerical and checkpoint checks are retained separately
